name: Generate brain extracted image with SynthStrip (T1w)
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 SynthStrip (mri_synthstrip) and outputs the brain-extracted image and a binary brain mask.
description: Runs mri_synthstrip, a deep-learning brain extraction tool that works across contrasts and resolutions, on the T1-weighted image. Use it when you need a brain-extracted T1-weighted image or brain mask before registration or segmentation. Needs only the T1-weighted image; the mask is in the input image space.

outputs.description: Binary brain mask (mask.nii.gz) in the input image space.

parameters.description: Name used for the output image file; fixed for this App.

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable on the compute resource.

failure_modes.cause: The brain-extracted image or mask was not produced.
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log for the mri_synthstrip error.
